originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: “片刻”“少许迹象”和 a breath of fresh air 的比喻义被混为一义；新点子令人耳目一新，并不表示时间短或数量少。应分开处理，将文学性时间义和少许迹象义移入拓展义。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 气息、一次呼吸、口气、fresh air 字面/比喻分开，缺实证的片刻义删去。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: 已取得的英语词条明确包含轻微气流义，原稿却仅在搭配中提及，缺少独立解释和两个例句。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 轻微气流独立核心双例。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: a breath of fresh air 的字面义和比喻义均不能直接归为“从口鼻呼出的气”。应移除这里的重复归类，在专门的短语义中说明。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: a breath of fresh air 移至专门短语义，区分字面与比喻。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: quiet 不等于“平稳”，as she fell asleep 也不等于“她睡着后”；该例用 breath 描述入睡过程也不够自然。改用常见的 out of breath 情境。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 睡着过程的生硬句换 out of breath 自然情境。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: 共有七个例句对象缺少结构要求的 note 字段，须补齐。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 原缺 note 英中例逐项补齐。

senseInventory.sense: a breath of fresh air：令人耳目一新的人或事

sourceEvidence.text: Breath continues Old English bræð, with meanings around an emitted smell, vapour, or exhalation. The modern breathing senses developed from this history. The related verb breathe preserves a longer vowel while breath has a short vowel; it is misleading to invent unrelated modern word pieces to explain the two spellings.
